EXPLANATION: The spectrum shows strong aliphatic C–H stretches at 2885 & 2941 cm⁻¹, a prominent isolated C=O stretch at 1741 cm⁻¹ (typical of a simple, non-conjugated ester), CH₂/CH₃ bending at 1454 cm⁻¹, and several medium bands in the 640–1040 cm⁻¹ region that fit C–O and skeletal/rocking modes of an aliphatic ester chain. Among the candidates, only molecule 1 (CCCCCOC(=O)C, pentyl acetate) is a single aliphatic ester without additional functional groups (no F, S, N, rings) that would introduce extra characteristic Raman bands; its functional groups and chain length best account for all observed peaks.
